decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Informative:
If you commence work on the ground floor extension (or any other extension) before you have completed the loft extension you will invalidate the lawful development certificate for the loft extension.  As a result you will be liable to enforcement action which may threaten any loan secured against the property and may result in prosecution attracting a fine, if successful, not exceeding ?20000.  It is likely also to make the property difficult to sell.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to house.
